scope: Fresh-process loading and post-warm residency on one Windows adapter. Working set and GPU process memory are sampled from Windows while the child holds its resources; they include driver state and are not isolated mesh allocations. Filesystem caches are not flushed. No network/loading claims for browser or cold OS boot.

rows.adapter: AdapterInfo { name: "Intel(R) Arc(TM) 140V GPU (16GB)", vendor: 32902, device: 25760, device_type: IntegratedGpu, device_pci_bus_id: "", driver: "Intel Corporation", driver_info: "101.8991", backend: Vulkan, subgroup_min_size: 16, subgroup_max_size: 32, transient_saves_memory: Some(false), limit_bucket: None }
rows.note: Fresh process, warm filesystem; load span excludes device setup and the following 16 rendered warm frames. RSS/HWM include allocator and driver state. Discrete retains source and LODs; cluster retains source fallback and all cluster buffers. No streaming or eviction.
